name: Al Jahra

queries.query: Kuwait official cadastral parcel map Al Jahra GIS land registry public map API
queries.result: First-party results identified PACI geospatial services and Kuwait Ministry of Justice real-estate registration procedures. The Ministry of Justice result identifies the Al Jahra real-estate registration office, but no public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the search result.

queries.query: كويت خريطة قطع الأراضي الرسمية الجهراء نظم المعلومات الجغرافية التسجيل العقاري
queries.result: First-party results identified PACI geospatial services, the PACI real-estate certificate service, the Kuwait Central Statistical Bureau GIS portal, and the Ministry of Justice real-estate registration branch in Al Jahra. No anonymous parcel geometry or public cadastral feature schema was returned.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kuwait Ministry of Justice, Real Estate Registration Department
registryEvidence.locality: Al Jahra governorate branch / Jahra New Courts Complex
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official procedures evidence a local registration custodian and real-estate certificates/registration workflows. It does not evidence a downloadable public parcel layer or citywide open geometry coverage.

parcelDiscovery.note: No parcel polygon was retained. The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not treated as an absence test.

uncertainty: PACI advertises geospatial services and links to exgisapps.paci.gov.kw, but the public host timed out on an ordinary TLS GET during this attempt.
The CSB GIS portal was reachable as a terms-of-service landing page, not as an inspectable parcel API; no login or terms acceptance was attempted.
The official Ministry of Finance GIS page describes an enterprise/state-property GIS project, not an anonymous Al Jahra cadastral parcel service.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
